segments.he: ר' אברהם ז"ל אמר לענין הציונים, הם תועים אבל תועים טוב לא"י. "זייא בלאנדיזין אבער זייא בלאנדזין גיט קיין ארץ ישראל". (והסוף והי' שיעשו תשובה).
segments.en: Reb Aharon the rabbi of Breslov — one of the greatest disciples of Rabbainu — at the last Rosh HaShanah of Rabbainu's life wanted to be with Rabbainu on Rosh HaShanah, but had great obstacles — for the whole city had begged him many times not to abandon them for Rosh HaShanah. He traveled himself before Rosh HaShanah to Uman and apologized to Rabbainu for the obstacles he faced. Rabbainu replied that he should be there for Rosh HaShanah. And then suddenly Rabbainu said: "What can I describe to you — the loss if you are not with me on Rosh HaShanah!" Reb Aharon said: "Then I will remain here." But Rabbainu replied: "But you have great obstacles!" And so it went back and forth many times — until finally Reb Aharon left Rabbainu. [For it was Rabbainu's way never to remove a person's free choice — only that the person himself should understand that he must break through the obstacles.]
